fields.title:
Onsite, pre go live training is conducted in dedicated training areas. The nature of buy/sells mean that training before go live may not always be possible, though it is ideal. 

Conference rooms, break rooms and any space that are away from distractions is preferred. The only requirements are that there is internet connectivity and between 3-4 dedicated training PCs (each with a keyboard and a mouse). Configuring additional, applicable hardware for users to be trained on is also recommended (common examples below):

Laser and impact printers
Label printers for deal jackets, parts special order labels and vehicle labels
Mobile devices for mobile repair order creation, parts scanning and vehicle barcode scanning
iPads for F&I Menu and forms casting
MICR printer for printing test checks
Your Tekion Implementation Manager will partner with you to finalize the arrangements and confirm the training schedule.

To the right, please provide the areas of the dealership that you have in mind for these training rooms.
